# KWAS Academy (academy.kwas.tech)
> Learn. Build. Master. An advanced, documentation-first technology and software engineering learning platform by KWAS Technologies (https://kwas.tech).

## Overview
KWAS Academy provides 100% free, paywall-free educational documentation, comprehensive roadmaps, interactive code sandboxes, and production project blueprints across 20+ software engineering disciplines.

## Official Curriculum Tracks
- HTML5 Documentation: https://academy.kwas.tech/learn/html

- React 19 Component Engineering: https://academy.kwas.tech/learn/react
- Next.js 16 Full-Stack App Router: https://academy.kwas.tech/learn/nextjs

- Python 3 Core & Algorithms: https://academy.kwas.tech/learn/python

- Java 21 Enterprise Development: https://academy.kwas.tech/learn/java
- C++20 Systems Programming: https://academy.kwas.tech/learn/cpp
